rv.q: The Lion King is a spectacular rendition of the animated film, a brilliant theatrical adaptation that stands on its own.
Playful and warm, funny and exciting, “The Lion King” will enchant children and adults in equal measure.
After all, on Oct. 15, it will be 19 years since that elephant took that first walk for the first preview of an epic masterwork and family classic.
Make no mistake: The Lion King is a rare theater experience.
Taymor's audacious staging expands a simple cub into the pride of Broadway, not merely a fable of heredity but a celebration of heritage.
Taymor populates the stage with an amazing menagerie of beasts; her audacious staging expands a simple cub into the pride of Broadway.

Julie Taymor has created a visual spectacular that is unlike anything else on Broadway, transforming the Theater into an African savanna where actors become antelopes, birds, and lions through ingenious costumes and masks.

Such is the transporting magic wrought by the opening 10 minutes of ''The Lion King,'' the director Julie Taymor's staged version of the Midas-touch cartoon movie that has generated millions for the Walt Disney Company.
Astonishing in 1997, and—yes—just as astonishing today.
A stunning stage event. Combining a graceful horde of actors, singers and dancers with a stylized world of fantastic puppets and theatrical wonderment.
Dude, this is to musicals what The Matrix is to martial arts movies.
The Lion King still roars and that nearly 13 years have hardly aged the show at all.
Now, the beauty is there, but the show feels a bit worn.
The spectacle, the imagination, the puppetry – all of it comes together in a way that can overwhelm any jaded theatergoer.
To say the effect is breathtaking is an understatement, it is overwhelming.
Julie Taymor's staging of Disney's 'The Lion King' is a marvel, a theatrical achievement unrivaled in its beauty, brains and ingenuity.
A triumph of theatrical imagination that reinvents the Disney animated classic for the stage...
Julie Taymor's staging is nothing short of miraculous...
A breathtaking spectacle that captures the spirit of Africa with stunning puppetry and costumes...
A theatrical experience unlike any other, thanks to director Julie Taymor...
Director Julie Taymor has fashioned a visual feast that is both dazzling and surprisingly intimate...
It is a wonderfully colorful spectacle with some of the most imaginative staging you are ever likely to see.
The most visually stunning Broadway musical in years...
As some critics have put it, the show is a visual masterpiece.
An exciting piece of theater for everyone but especially for those unfamiliar with Disney's brilliant, Oscar-winning 1994 animated film...
If you have not been a Disney fan you will be knocked out by this transformation of an animated film to a live theater piece.
The Lion King is not a product of re-creation but one of creation.
But it is also dazzling, one-of-a-kind entertainment.
A quarter century on, there are still few productions that have so boldly embraced scale and experimentalism at the same time.

So come find out what all the fuss is about, and re-introduce the kids to all their favorite characters -- Simba, Nala, Mufasa, Zazu and of course, Timon and Pumbaa -- in a vibrant, colorful and magical new way.
